_readme: Electrical steel grades offered. Edit the text values freely; keep the keys. Shown on the home page, /materials and each product page.

materials.name: Cold-Rolled Grain-Oriented electrical steel
materials.grades: 70 to 120 grade, depending on material specification and availability
materials.summary: Primarily used in transformer cores because its directional magnetic properties make it suitable for efficient magnetic flux conduction.
materials.detail: Proper material selection and precision processing are important for achieving the required core performance.

materials.name: Cold-Rolled Non-Grain-Oriented electrical steel
materials.grades: Final grade selection is based on customer specifications and availability
materials.summary: Magnetic properties that are less direction-dependent than CRGO.
materials.detail: Used in a variety of electrical applications, depending on the design and performance requirements.
